data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly requires drawing on published definitions to establish the precise distinction between idempotent and safe. SRC_001's definitions, derivation, and formalization_refs arrays are all empty, and it proposes no research fetches. Its offered distinction (safety = identifiable retries at the write layer, idempotency = deduplication effect at the replay layer) is an architectural role assignment, not the precise conceptual distinction the problem asks for. The standard published distinction is mathematical: idempotency means f∘f = f (repeating the operation yields the same effect as performing it once), whereas safety means the operation cannot drive the system into a state that violates invariants. SRC_001 never articulates this, so it fails to meet the problem's stated requirement to ground the distinction in published definitions.
